data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100. This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Fisher17/24/13/19, help recruit.
